newsitem.title: USA: Tri Polyta Indonesia unit files $175mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Tri Polyta Indonesia unit files $175mln debt.

text.p: PT Tri Polyta Finance BV, a unit of Tri Polyta Indonesia Tbk, filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commmission for up to $175 million in guaranteed secured notes due 2003.
The unit said it will lend net proceeds from the sale of the notes to its parent, which will use the funds to refinance debt and to make investments in certain petrochemical projects.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Lehman Bros. and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp.
Tri Polyta Indonesia is a major Indonesian producer of polypropylene resins.
